cli: python engine/agent/server.py --state-dir <private per-user Agent> --ui-dir <resources/tools-ui> [--port 4323] [--allowed-origin <exact URL origin> ...]
engineImport: server.py parent-parent is engine/ containing engine.py and deps, runtimes; no --engine-path needed
device: same identity fields as health, status:'connected', lastSeen:ISO UTC
nativeHeartbeat: bridge/status.json atomically written every 2 sec {version:1,pid:<nativepid>,updatedAt:<Unixseconds>,os:'macOS|Windows'}; stale >12 sec means offline
nativeSignals: bridge/signals/<uuid>.json atomically write {id:<uuid>,operation:'web.capture'|'record.toggle',args:{},createdAt:<Unix seconds>}; root consumes and deletes. Only exact allowlist, stale >30 sec rejected.
nativeSettings: settings.apply args shortcuts keys areaCapture/fullCapture/webCapture/recordToggle string normalized modifier+key. Empty disables. settings operation returns ok:false/errorCode:'shortcutConflict' on duplicate/native registration failure; don't overwrite working old shortcut set on failure.
errors: short stable errorCode keys e.g invalidRequest, forbiddenOrigin, unauthorized, pairingDenied, cancelled, permissionRequired, nativeUnavailable, unsupported, inputMissing, processingFailed, conflict. UI t('tools.error.'+code), no untrusted raw error HTML.
security: All non-health/non-tools endpoints exact Origin and token require. Pair exact allowlisted origin but no token -> native approval. File paths only native bridge, opaque IDs HTTP. SSE event:type lines with JSON data; token never URL. Artifact binary authorized fetch then Blob URL. DELETE /pair token revocation. POST /jobs/<id>/cancel.

phone.errorCode: optional short typed code; no raw ADB output
